svg.text: OPTION 5 - STAIRCASE DETAILS (both stairs), scale 1 ft = 24 px
Positions x are feet from the front boundary, as on the floor plans. Blue = dimensions. Red = openings needed in the slab above. Brown = treads.
Straight flight along the west wall of the portico. 21 risers x 6" = 10'6" floor to floor. 20 treads x 10" = 16'8" run. Width 4'0" clear.
west building line (1' setback, then apartment wall)
tread numbers 1 .. 20, riser 21 lands on the lobby floor at x = 24'
first-floor lobby slab above has a VOID over this strip
from x = 14' to 24' (4' x 10') so headroom is never below 7'
first riser is 2'4" behind the trunk base

Support: RCC waist slab 5" (125 mm) on two side beams, columns at x = 14' and 24' (portico columns). Bottom step on a 9" plinth beam at x = 7'4" (keep the beam shallow, 1'6" max, to spare the neem roots).
Handrail 3'6" high on the open (east) side, wall rail on the west. Nosing 1". Anti-skid tiles.
Heights in feet from portico floor. Under-stair store between x 18' and 24' has 6'5" to 10'0" headroom.
from x = 14' (over the car side only, void over the stair)
Note: 21 risers in one flight (6" risers are gentle, which is why you chose them). NBC 2016 prefers a landing after 12 to 15 risers. If the approving office insists:
use a dog-leg of two 4' flights (10 + 11 risers) with a 4' x 8' mid landing, footprint 8' x 12'4" at the west of the portico, two-wheelers parked under it.
Dog-leg in its own band behind the hall (x 69' to 75'6"). Two flights of 9 risers x 7", 8 treads x 10" each. Flight width 3'3". Landing 6'6" x 3'3".
(window on west wall lights the stair)
store door under landing, from dining side
Flight A rises from the passage to the mid landing at 5'3". Flight B rises to the first-floor corridor at 10'6". Store under the landing has 4'10" headroom.
VOID over both flights and landing (6'6" x 12'4")
Headroom over flight A measured to the first-floor corridor slab edge at y = 3'3": 10'6" - 0'5" slab - 0'7" (first riser) = 9'6". Fine.
Headroom over flight B at the landing to the hall roof (phase 2, 11' above first floor): no issue. Stair continues to the hall roof in phase 3 by adding a third flight pair in the same well.
Floor to floor 10'6" (3.20 m) on the ground floor. All dimensions clear of finishes except where noted.
Straight flight, open on east side
Own band x 69' to 75'6", behind hall
None mid-flight; lobby floor is the top landing
Bottom: passage 6'6" x 3'3". Mid: 6'6" x 3'3" at 5'3". Top: corridor 6'6" x 3'3"
4'0" x 10'0" void in lobby slab, x 14' to 24'
9'6" over flight A; full over flight B
Store under mid landing 6'6" x 5'8", headroom 4'10"
3'6" high, east side; wall rail west
3'0" to 3'3" high on the open (inner) side
5" RCC waist slab on side beams; shallow plinth beam at 7'4"
RCC waist slab 5" spanning wall to wall (6'6")
